meta.name: The Weather, in Objects
meta.description: A weather forecast without a video file. The map is a picture; clouds, temperatures, charts and warnings are overlays that the player animates in time, with a narrator and captions in two languages.
meta.creator: demo

frametrail:attributes.text: <p><span style="font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700;">Tomorrow on the island</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 17px;">The forecast for Wednesday</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700;">Nothing here is a video.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 15px;">The map is a picture. The clouds, numbers and charts are objects that the player moves and draws as the time runs. Open the editor and move the sun.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700;">The whole island</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 17px;">Cloud in the morning, clearing later</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700;">Highlands</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 17px;">Rain until the afternoon, 11°</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; color: #0c2f4a;">Heavy rain around noon</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 15px; color: #0c2f4a;">Take care on the mountain paths.</span></p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 17px;">9 of 15 daylight hours</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 15px;">SUNRISE</span> <span style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700;">6:21</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 15px;">SUNSET</span> <span style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700;">20:47</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700;">The days ahead</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 17px;">Thursday to Saturday</span></p>

<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700;">Thursday</span></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 17px;">Showers</span></p><p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700;">13°</span></p>

<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700;">Friday</span></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 17px;">Sunshine</span></p><p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700;">16°</span></p>

<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700;">Saturday</span></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 17px;">Warm and still</span></p><p style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700;">19°</span></p>
